requiredChecks: cd platform_v2 && npm ci && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:node
cd platform_v2/cloudflare_shadow && npm ci && npm run check && npm test && npm run deploy:production:dry-run
notes: Production deploy is triggered only by merge to main and GitHub Actions.
The production public entrypoint is Cloudflare Worker ikimon-life-cloudflare-prod, not the legacy VPS blue/green lane.

The production workflow deploys the Worker with the guarded Cloudflare script and materializes the core original UI HTML, including /record and /ja/record app shells, plus original-ui/static/app-sw.js into R2. The R2 materializer records a whole-bundle manifest and skips R2 writes when the generated bundle hash is unchanged.
The production Worker must not own staging.ikimon.life routes; Cloudflare staging owns staging.ikimon.life/* through ikimon-life-cloudflare-staging.
Routine production deploy must not use VPS SSH, deploy_platform_v2_blue_green.sh, or VPS_SSH_KEY.
Routine production deploy must not change DNS, custom domains, D1 data, secrets, billing, provider settings, or VPS state.

R2 writes in routine deploy are limited to original-ui/html core materialized HTML app shells, original-ui/static/app-sw.js generated from the same commit, and original-ui/materialize-manifest/* optimization metadata.
